method: Sharp dates from Esri World Imagery Wayback captures (Maxar/Vantor WorldView, GeoEye, Legion; 0.3-0.5 m; pre-2017 captures only published at zoom 17, ~1.2 m). Per building: the captures whose metadata polygons cover its whole crop (footprint box + 7 m) in the release that made the tile bytes; captures coarser than 0.6 m and panchromatic ones are skipped. Footprints registered per capture (capture-wide shift, per-tile shift from footprints >= 100 m2, +-2 px per building), on outline edge strength. Observations under cloud or haze (context or footprint) are unknown. P(roof) per observation from a small neural net on 31 edge/vegetation/contrast/texture/colour/shadow features: round 1 self-supervised (footprint in its newest capture vs the same shape moved onto open ground), round 2 retrained on every capture with labels from the round-1 dating, cross-fitted by tile. Dating: one change point per building (absent, then present, optionally demolished) fitted jointly over all buildings by EM, with per-capture error rates learned from the data over P(roof) x similarity to the building's current look, and an appearance-year prior. first = capture where it first shows (-1 = there by its earliest usable capture earliest[]; -2 = no current-building date, see status); before = last usable capture before it, read as open ground. conf = posterior probability that the date is right within one capture (there by: first or second capture; not seen / demolished: probability of that state). status: 0 dated, 1 dated with conf < 0.5, 2 there by, 3 not seen as a roof in any usable capture, 4 no usable capture, 5 demolished (gone = capture where it is gone). small = footprint under 25 m2 (tank, shed): treat its date as indicative only.
